text:
sam: Quick proposal — add a "graceful shedding" route policy that prefers cheap quantized backups before tripping tenant-level circuit breakers. Want quick feedback before I spin up a PoC in staging. :eyes:

maria: sgtm in principle. Do you mean we try a reduced-quality model first and only flip the CB when backup latency or error rate exceeds a threshold? Also want header hints so routers can prefer warm backups if tenant requests it (e.g. x-tenant-prefer-backup).

jordan: Yup. Also need to be explicit about telemetry hooks. We should emit: backup_invocations, backup_latency_ms, cb_trips, shed_rate, and per-tenant fallback_path. Console needs a per-tenant histogram and the ability to pivot by model variant.

leah: For rollout UX: canary the policy on ~1% of traffic, monitor regressions, then lift to 10/50/100. The console should let SREs adjust thresholds on the fly (e.g., alter trip_pct or sequence order) without redeploying. Example config sketch below — mostly for discussion, not final syntax:

```
route: /v1/generate
match:
  header: x-tenant-tier
policy:
  degrade_sequence:
    - model: redwood-xl-quant
      max_latency_ms: 500
      max_error_rate: 0.02
    - model: redwood-medium-quant
      max_latency_ms: 800
circuit_breaker:
  window_s: 60
  min_requests: 50
  trip_pct: 0.25
headers:
  preserve: ["x-request-id","x-tenant-id"]
  internal_override: {"x-internal-fallback":"true"}
```

maria: A couple concerns: 1) header naming — don't leak internal flags to customers. Use x-internal-* and strip at edge for hosted. 2) quota accounting: if we route to backups we must decide whether to charge at original model rate or backup model rate. That affects billing and alerts.

jordan: On telemetry, make sure traces include the full degrade_sequence path and timing for each hop (prefetch, kv cache hit, model dispatch). Add an event when a CB trips with top-3 contributing tenants so we can debug noisy neighbors.

opsbot: :rotating_light: deploybot: started rollout of "graceful-shedding-prototype" to staging (canary=2%) by sam at 1997733350

leah: Alerting proposals: fire an alert when cb_trips > 5% over 5m for any tenant; also alert on backup_invocations spike correlated with latency. Dash panels: 1) per-tenant fallback rate heatmap 2) sequence-level p95/p99 latency 3)CB trip timeline with tenant leaderboards.

sam: Great points. I'll: 1) change header to x-internal-fallback and ensure edge strips it; 2) prototype charging logic in billing-sim to recommend fee policy; 3) wire metrics and dashboards for the panels leah suggested. Will ping infra for quota headroom since backups may increase GPU usage but lower per-token work.

maria: :+1: Also leave a rollout kill-switch in console — if quality regressions are detected (eval score delta > 0.05) automatically rollback canary and notify oncall.

jordan: Quick note on implementation: runtime should prefer warm-prefixes in KV cache when selecting backups; add a small jitter to avoid synchronized fallback storms.

sam: Cool — I'll push the PoC config to staging and post results here. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
